title: Assam: Koch-Rajbongshi groups stage protest in Bongaigaon, demand Kamatapur state, ST status

ai.summary: Koch-Rajbongshi groups staged a three-hour sit-in protest in Assam's Bongaigaon on November 16, demanding a separate Kamatapur state and Scheduled Tribe status for their community.
